name: devkit-openspec
description: Runs the devkit flow on top of OpenSpec: the devkit and devkit-lite schemas (grill → plan → readiness → TDD → evidence → review) and hooks that keep product code closed until readiness is APPROVED and refuse a PR without an approved review and evidence, and flow-check, which reads each stage file's header and says which stage passed and which comes next, and `/devkit change`, which runs one change as a loop over the checker, with locks that keep it from stopping early or writing code, and `/devkit roadmap`, which runs the roadmap's ready changes, several at once, with `/devkit status`, and `/devkit project`, which defines a project or one slice of it in the devkit-project schema.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the /devkit replies and of the stage readout: pt-BR or en

load_limit.title: Load limit
load_limit.description: Processor load, in percent, above which /devkit roadmap starts no new change: a whole number from 1 up (default 80)
